name: recover
instructions: For a phone/email validation failure before anything was saved in Remitly, Maker owns the retry. With a current owned browser lease, inspect the current provider contact/draft/history state and call pulse_payout_retry_recipient_creation with the latest recipientCorrection.hash, current unknown/expired attempt, fresh observedAt, sourceUrl, stable observationId, protected evidence and historyCoverage. Confirm noRecipientSaved and noDraftSaved plus historyInspected, recipientRecordInspected, recipientCorrectionApplied, noRecipientLinkIssued, noFundsSent, noFundingDebit, noPendingTransfers, noUnknownTransfers and previousDraftClosed. Absence of a recipient/draft satisfies inspection and closure only when actually verified; recipientCorrectionApplied means the corrected saved details will be used by the fresh attempt. Never invent a record or claim an edit to an absent contact. Saved draft/contact markers, recorded payment/link/activity, human decline/release, mixed name/other errors, stale corrections or paused preparation block this retry. Success keeps the SAME withdrawal and coins reserved, closes the failed internal attempt, applies the saved correction and clears the old quote/check. Continue with a fresh quote and durable preparation attempt in the same Maker run; checker review and human final sending remain required.
Stop browser actions and scheduled work for the affected role/account before attempting recovery. Never delete local or backend leases to force parallel access.
Read the existing backend attempt and audit history. Record what was observed and what remains unknown; retain all coin reservations while an action may have reached Remitly.

On an expired/lost browser or attempt lease, stop provider mutations and inspect current contacts/drafts/activity under a fresh owned browser lease before new preparation. Maker can retry only a structured phone/email rejection verified to have saved no provider record; generic interruptions remain uncertain and must not be replayed.

Browser logout/MFA/CAPTCHA requires human session recovery. Changed provider selectors, unverified link patterns, method restrictions or changed account identity require an updated validated playbook; do not guess.
An expired scheduled draft is not proof of funding return or absence of other drafts. Verify actual provider cancellation/return and historical coverage before releasing coins or retrying.

A human decline before any provider attempt can cancel and refund through the protected backend. A decline after an attempt blocks release and retains coins until provider reconciliation verifies resolution.

Revoked/expired role credentials stop the job. The owner issues a replacement credential for the same intended environment/account/role, and the local Mac Keychain stores it without putting the token in commands, files or logs.

A crashed local run keeps its local lock. Confirm its process is stopped, record provider investigation in the backend and note the expected run ID before using the explicit local recovery command. Local cleanup does not change backend state or authorize another provider action.

If computer sleep/app closure interrupts an automation, treat possible provider actions as uncertain; no catch-up run may blindly replay draft creation. Obtain new identity/health checks and leases on resume.

If browser capability or custom MCP access is unavailable in the actual Codex automation, report the blocked capability and leave the item unchanged. Manual installation/verification is separate from delivery of this package.
Complete with only a redacted status/count summary. The human alone performs final sending or link issuance; recovery does not waive that boundary.

Guarded recovery is explicitly approved. With a current owned browser lease, only the reconciler may call pulse_payout_resolve_recipient_error for the latest recipientCorrection.hash and current unknown/expired attempt. Independently verify the corrected contact and relevant provider history; all nine checks must be true: historyInspected, recipientRecordInspected, recipientCorrectionApplied, noRecipientLinkIssued, noFundsSent, noFundingDebit, noPendingTransfers, noUnknownTransfers, previousDraftClosed. Any recorded human decline/release, provider transfer reference/activity or issued link blocks recovery. Use signed-in sourceUrl, fresh observedAt, stable observationId, historyCoverage and protected evidence. Success definitively closes the old attempt, applies corrected snapshot/version, clears old quote/check and returns the SAME withdrawal to awaiting_quote with coins still reserved. Never send automatically; maker obtains a fresh quote, checker independently checks, and human sends.

recipientCorrectionApplied permits two evidence branches: an existing provider contact was updated, OR inspection confirmed no provider contact was persisted and the next fresh preparation will use the corrected details. Record which branch in protected evidence. Mixed rejected name/other fields cannot be cleared by phone/email recovery; investigate those errors separately.

A saved phone/email correction is sufficient user input; never demand another edit, recovery form or quote approval. Maker uses retry_recipient_creation for verified unsaved validation failures. Reconciliation verifies sent-transfer outcomes; saved or uncertain provider records require existing-record investigation rather than blind recreation. Do not re-report unchanged old rejection evidence to erase the pending correction. Report a specific capability or evidence blocker if retry cannot be verified, without borrowing another role credential.
